title: Morphisms to the section-ring Proj with the fraction formula
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and L an invertible module [def-sc-invertible-module]. Let S be its graded section ring [def-sc-invertible-section-ring]. Assume that for every x in X there is a homogeneous s of positive degree d with x in the nonvanishing locus of s [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module]. There exists f:X -> Proj(S) [def-pc-proj] such that for every positive-degree homogeneous s, n >= 0 and homogeneous xi of degree nd, the pullback of xi/s^n on f^{-1}(D_+(s)), multiplied by the restricted tensor-power section s^n, is the restricted section xi. No assertion about the inverse-image locus is included.

source.place: Constructions Lemma 01N8 (lemma-converse-construction), local quotient construction, overlap and inverse-image calculation; Properties Lemma 01PZ (lemma-map-into-proj), proof and clause (1)

proof.text: Index all positive-degree homogeneous sections. Apply nonvanishing_section_trivializes to each tensor power (tensor powers of an invertible module are invertible) and retain the resulting nonvanishing open. These opens cover X by hcover.
Apply the compatible local quotient charts lemma to this family. It supplies morphisms on these opens, pairwise compatibility, and the intrinsic local fraction formula.
Glue the compatible maps by Scheme.Opens.glueMorphismsOfTop, the intersection form of scheme morphism gluing. Its restriction lemma identifies the glued morphism with each local map.

For an arbitrary positive-degree chart D_+(t), restrict the desired equation to the ambient images of the inverse images of D_+(t) in each U_i. These opens cover the full inverse image. Rewrite the local maps as U_i.ι followed by the glued morphism; comp_app and ι_app identify the scalar restriction. map_smul and composition of presheaf restrictions turn the local formula into equality of restrictions of the two desired sections. TopCat.Sheaf.eq_of_locally_eq' gives their equality on the entire inverse-image open, including an empty one.

proof_origin.note: Lean reduction of the local chart plan: cover, actual gluing, and sheaf separatedness are proved; only compatible local quotient data are split off.

mathlib_searches.query: A scheme covered by nonvanishing loci of sections of an invertible module admits a morphism to Proj of its graded section ring pulling back homogeneous fractions as quotients of tensor power sections

The fraction pullback identity for a morphism into Proj implies that a point is in the inverse image of a homogeneous basic open exactly when the corresponding invertible module section does not vanish
